$comment: GitHub's About panel, as a file. The API needs Administration: write, which GITHUB_TOKEN cannot hold, so .github/workflows/ops.yml applies this with a repository-scoped PAT. Editing it here means the sidebar is reviewed like anything else instead of typed into a web form nobody sees again.
description: Nine checks that stop an AI coding agent from calling unfinished work done. Zero dependencies, any language, any agent.
